title: Past Experiences, Reading & Time
subtitle: Talk about completed actions, use irregular verbs, and describe when things happened.

sections.label: Lesson Notes
sections.title: What we explored
sections.intro: We practised past simple forms, irregular verbs, negatives, questions, reading for detail, and prepositions of time.

cards.title: Completed actions
cards.text: Use past simple for an action that finished in the past.

cards.title: Questions and negatives
cards.text: Use did / didn’t + the base verb.

cards.title: Time phrases
cards.text: Use on for days, in for months and years, and at for clock times.

readings.title: A busy Saturday
readings.text: Last Saturday, Deniz went to a café with a friend. They had lunch at one o’clock and talked about their week.
